title: Buildings Models 3D - Scene Layer
description:
A collection of multipatches features for all buildings within the Urban Development Boundary (UDB) and outside the UDB, approximately 938 square miles. 
Please contact the GIS Technical Support Team at gis@miamidade.gov for additional information.

The source feature class can be downloaded from this link.
